## 1. `LocalHostServer` — location and route registration

**`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\.gold-band\worktrees\task-025\run-001\dyn-e6e6c780246db725\ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\web\LocalHostServer.java`** (1616 lines, package `io.github.diodeme.ji.host.web`, module `ji-host-web`).

There are **no separate handler classes** — every route dispatches to a private method on `LocalHostServer` itself. Registration is all in one block of the private constructor, each wrapped in `guard(exchange, …)` which is the single exception→problem-JSON funnel:

`LocalHostServer.java:252-271`
```java
server.createContext("/api/v1/auth/local/exchange", exchange -> guard(exchange, () -> exchange(exchange)));
server.createContext("/api/v1/host",          exchange -> guard(exchange, () -> host(exchange)));
server.createContext("/api/v1/sessions",      exchange -> guard(exchange, () -> sessions(exchange)));
...
server.createContext("/", exchange -> guard(exchange, () -> staticAsset(exchange)));
```

| Route (context) | Dispatch method | Line of method | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/auth/local/exchange` | `exchange()` | 327 | POST; only unauthenticated route |
| `/api/v1/host` | `host()` | 340 | GET |
| `/api/v1/sessions` | `sessions()` | 354 | sub-dispatches by path segment index `parts[5]`: `snapshot`, `timeline`, `tree`, `status`, `compactions`, `navigate`, `navigations`, `labels`, `fork`, `composer`, `queue`, `prompt`, `abort` |
| `/api/v1/sessions/{id}/composer` | `composer()` | 498 | GET/PUT |
| `/api/v1/sessions/{id}/queue` | `queue()` | 786 | GET/POST |
| `/api/v1/sessions/{id}/compactions[/{op}]` | `compactions()` / `compaction()` | 476 / 484 | POST |
| `/api/v1/provider-profiles` | `providerProfiles()` | 521 | GET list, GET/PUT `/{id}` |
| `/api/v1/credentials` | `credentials()` | 552 | GET/PUT/DELETE `/{id}` |
| `/api/v1/resources` | `resources()` | 600 | GET/POST |
| `/api/v1/extensions` | `extensions()` | 617 | GET/POST/DELETE + `/{id}/{reload\|trust\|enable\|disable}` |
| `/api/v1/project-trust` | `projectTrust()` | 756 | GET/PUT |
| `/api/v1/devices` | `devices()` | 770 | GET list, DELETE `/{id}` |
| `/api/v1/search` | `search()` | 825 | GET |
| `/api/v1/artifacts` | `artifacts()` | 862 | POST multipart, GET `/{id}` (Range) |
| `/api/v1/artifact-uploads` | `artifactUploads()` | 1021 | POST, PUT `/{id}/chunks/{n}`, POST `/{id}/complete`, DELETE |
| `/api/v1/permissions/{permissionId}` | `permissions()` | 1082 | POST decision |
| `/api/v1/health/live`, `/api/v1/health/ready` | `health()` | 1057 | GET; **not** authenticated |
| `/` (catch-all) | `staticAsset()` | 1062 | GET only, 405 otherwise |

Server setup: `HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), port), 0)` at `:248`, virtual-thread executor at `:250`. HCP WebSocket started on a separate loopback port at `:272-275`.

## 2. Session cookie / loopback enforcement (what exists today)

**What exists:**

- Constant `COOKIE = "ji_local_session"` — `:58`.
- In-memory cookie set: `private final Set<String> cookies = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();` — `:84`.
- Cookie validation: `authenticated()` at `:1367-1372` parses the `Cookie` header, filters `ji_local_session=`, and matches against the in-memory set. `requireAuthenticated()` at `:1374-1377` throws `PERMISSION_DENIED` with `parameters = {permissionId: "local-session", tool: "host-api"}`.
- Cookie issuance: `Set-Cookie: ji_local_session=<v>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/` — `:335-336` (REST exchange) and `LocalBrowserLaunch.java:70-71` (launch redirect).
- Loopback check exists **only in the token-exchange path**: `:330-331`
  ```java
  Optional<String> cookie = tokens.exchange(requiredText(body, "token"),
          exchange.getRemoteAddress().getAddress().isLoopbackAddress());
  ```
  and in `LocalBrowserLaunch.exchange()` at `LocalBrowserLaunch.java:59-63` (`getRemoteAddress().getAddress().isLoopbackAddress()`), plus the socket bind itself to `InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress()`.
- `LocalTokenService.exchange(token, loopbackRequest)` — `LocalTokenService.java:33-40`: `if (!loopbackRequest || token =[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] null) return Optional.empty();` — one-use (digest removed from map), 2-minute TTL, SHA-256 digest only retained.
- HCP WebSocket handshake gating: `HcpWebSocketServer.java:68-76` requires resource `/hcp/v1`, and `authorized(cookieHeader)` at `:273-279` reuses the same cookie predicate (`cookies::contains` passed at `LocalHostServer.java:272`).

**What does NOT exist (this is the gap):**

- **No Origin validation, no Host header validation, no custom-header requirement, no JSON-content-type enforcement.** A full grep for `getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Origin"` / `"Host"` / `"X-…"` across the repo returns hits only in `RelayApplication.java` (`X-JI-Terminal-Bootstrap`, `Origin` for CORS) and one provider test — nothing in `LocalHostServer`.
- **No "loopback subject" check on the guarded routes.** `guard()` (`:1391-1410`) does no source check; `requireAuthenticated()` only looks at the cookie. The loopback predicate is applied solely when redeeming a launch token, so a same-site/CSRF request that somehow carries the cookie is not additionally filtered by origin.
- The design doc confirms this is planned, not built: `docs\java-rewrite\18-client-orchestration.md:111-112` — "编排入口只接受**本地回环主体**；Relay 连接设备一律 `permission.denied`… 本地来源校验：要求非简单请求（自定义头 + JSON content type）并校验 Origin/Host，防跨站与 DNS rebinding。现有会话 cookie 已为 `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`，但仍需显式来源校验。"

## 3. Where `permission.denied` is produced, and local vs. HCP/relay distinction

Stable code lives in the generated catalog: `ji-java\protocols\ji-error-catalog\src\generated\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\error\ErrorCode.java:70` → `PERMISSION_DENIED("permission.denied")`; declared contract `contracts\errors\catalog.json:70` with `parameters: ["permissionId", "tool"]`, `httpStatus: 403`, `cliExit: 3`.

**Local REST production sites (all in `LocalHostServer.java`):**
- `:332-333` — launch-token exchange rejected: `Map.of("permissionId", "local-launch", "tool", "host-auth")`
- `:851-852` and `:1485-1487`, `:1492-1494` — artifact scope mismatch: `Map.of("permissionId", "artifact-scope", "tool", "artifact")`
- `:1375-1376` — missing/invalid session cookie: `Map.of("permissionId", "local-session", "tool", "host-api")`

**HCP production sites (`HcpSessionGateway.java`):**
- `:193` and `:1020` — `error(connectionId, "permission.denied", "pairing_rejected")`
- `:249` — catch of `SecurityException` (from `ConnectionPrincipal.require`) → `"scope_denied"`
- `:798` — host-query `SecurityException` → `"scope_denied"`

**How local browser sessions are distinguished from HCP / relay devices** — this is the load-bearing bit for your task:

`LocalHostServer.java:583-587`
```java
/** The loopback REST entry has no paired device identity; it is audited as a direct local Controller. */
private ConnectionPrincipal localPrincipal() {
    return new ConnectionPrincipal("local-rest", "local-rest", "local-session", hostId, "direct", "",
            HostRole.CONTROLLER, HostRole.CONTROLLER.scopes(), Instant.now());
}
```
The synthetic principal is the *only* place the REST surface mints an identity, and it is hard-coded `transport = "direct"`. It is used **only** by the credentials route (`:559`, `service.read/save/clear(principal, …)`). Every other REST route passes no principal at all, so downstream services (`PermissionApplicationService`, `PromptApplicationService`) see `null` and fall back to the local path (e.g. `prompts.promptRich(..., "local")` at `:436`, `AuditActor.direct()` at `:517`).

Real HCP identities carry `transport = "direct"` (local loopback WebSocket, `HcpWebSocketServer.java:121-123` passes literal `"direct"`) or `transport = "relay"` (`HostRelayConnector.java:455-456` and `:476-478` pass `"relay"`, `routeId`). `HostRole` scopes gate what each may do (`HostRole.java:11-19`): `OBSERVER`/`CONTROLLER`/`HOST_ADMIN`; relay pairing is forced to `HostRole.CONTROLLER` (`HostRelayConnector.java:449-450`), and credential management is deliberately granted to `CONTROLLER` (`HostRole.java:7-9`).

Note the two "direct" transports are **not** distinguishable by the `transport` field alone — a loopback HCP device and the REST surface both say `"direct"`; only `deviceId`/`clientId` differ (`"local-rest"`/`"local-session"` vs a real paired device id).

## 4. JSON encoding conventions

- **Jackson `ObjectMapper`, hand-built.** `private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();` — `LocalHostServer.java:83`. No custom modules, no `@JsonProperty` DTOs.
- **No DTO classes for transport.** Request bodies are decoded as `Map<String,Object>` (`readMap()` at `:1385-1389`, capped at 1 MiB) and responses are built as `Map.of(...)` / `LinkedHashMap` literals. Responses go out via `json(exchange, status, body)` at `:1443-1445` → `application/json`; `bytes()` at `:1447-1453` also sets `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- **Error response shape** — RFC-7807-style problem document, `problem()` at `:1412-1424`:
  ```java
  body.put("type", "https://ji.invalid/problems/" + error.code().code());
  body.put("status", httpStatus(error.code()));
  body.put("code", error.code().code());
  body.put("parameters", error.parameters());
  error.traceId().ifPresent(...); error.retryAfter().ifPresent(...); error.currentRevision().ifPresent(...);
  bytes(exchange, httpStatus(error.code()), "application/problem+json", ...);
  ```
  Error model: `JiError` record at `ji-java\protocols\ji-error-catalog\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\error\JiError.java:10-15` — `(ErrorCode code, Map<String,String> parameters, Optional<String> traceId, Optional<Duration> retryAfter, OptionalLong currentRevision)`; thrown via `JiException`. `httpStatus()` mapping at `:1426-1441`.
- **Frontend counterpart:** `ji-java\web\app\src\lib\api.ts:30-43` (`ApiProblem`, `credentials: "same-origin"`, auto `Content-Type: application/json` unless `FormData`, branches on `application/problem+json`); `ProblemDetails` TS type at `web/app/src/lib/types.ts:221-229`.
- Field-name convention is camelCase throughout; enums are lower-cased on the wire (e.g. `:1142`, `:1214`); empty optionals serialize as `""` rather than `null` for several fields.

## 5. `staticAsset` / classpath `/web/index.html`

`LocalHostServer.java:1062-1080`:
```java
private void staticAsset(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
    if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) { status(exchange, 405); return; }
    String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
    if (path.equals("/")) path = "/index.html";
    if (path.contains("..")) { status(exchange, 404); return; }
    try (var input = LocalHostServer.class.getResourceAsStream("/web" + path)) {
        if (input == null && !path.contains(".")) {          // SPA deep-link fallback
            try (var index = LocalHostServer.class.getResourceAsStream("/web/index.html")) { ... }
        }
        ...
        String contentType = path.endsWith(".js") ? "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
                : path.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css; charset=utf-8" : "text/html; charset=utf-8";
```
Classpath root `/web` is populated at build time — `ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\build.gradle.kts:22-35`: `webBuild` runs `corepack pnpm build` in `ji-java/web/app`, then `processResources { from(webAppDir.dir("dist")) { into("web") } }`. Note this route is **not** cookie-guarded in practice (it calls `guard` but `staticAsset` never calls `requireAuthenticated`), and there is no `Cache-Control` header.

## 6. Existing audit-event infrastructure

- **`SecurityAuditLog`** — `ji-java\applications\ji-host-core\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\SecurityAuditLog.java`. Constants `RETENTION = 90 days` (`:26`), `MAXIMUM_ENTRIES = 10_000` (`:28`), file name `security-audit.ndjson` (`:36`). Constructors/helpers: `inDataDirectory(Path)` at `:50-53` and `inDirectory(Path, Clock)` at `:56-59`. Typed emitters: `credentialChanged(...)` at `:70-78`, `permissionModeChanged(...)` at `:85-97`, `hostPermissionModeDefault(...)` at `:100-108`. The documented single extension point:
  ```java
  /** {@link #append} is the single extension point for further audited events. */
  public void append(String type, Map<String, String> fields)  // :115-127
  ```
  Event-type constants: `CREDENTIAL_CHANGED = "credential.changed"` (`:30`), `PERMISSION_MODE_CHANGED = "permission.mode.changed"` (`:32`), `SOURCE_HOST_DEFAULT`/`SOURCE_SESSION_CONFIG` (`:34-35`). Fields are capped at 256 chars (`:37`, `:121`) and secret material is contractually forbidden (`:14-23`).
- **`RetentionLog`** — `ji-host-core\...\RetentionLog.java`. NDJSON, `MAXIMUM_LINE_BYTES = 4 KiB` (`:20`), `MAXIMUM_FILE_BYTES = 16 MiB` (`:21`), atomic compaction, and a **hard field allowlist** at `:24-27`:
  ```java
  private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_FIELDS = Set.of(
      "hostId", "workspaceId", "sessionId", "operationId", "clientId", "deviceId",
      "permissionId", "tool", "ruleId", "provider", "status", "code", "traceId",
      "credentialId", "revision", "role", "transport", "mode", "previousMode", "source");
  ```
  Non-allowlisted fields are silently dropped at `:44-51` — so any new audit event must add its field names to this set. `Entry` record is `(id, occurredAt, type, fields)`.
- Existing callers: `CredentialApplicationService.java:60` and `:69` (credential writes/clears); `ProviderProfileApplicationService.java:67-71` (permission-mode change). `SecurityAuditLog` is **not** wired into `LocalHostServer` at all today — the REST surface never emits audit entries.
- Tests: `ji-host-core\src\test\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\SecurityAuditLogTest.java`.

## 7. Credential store / master-key ACL / data-directory helpers

- **`CredentialStore` interface** — `ji-java\core\ji-security-api\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\security\secret\CredentialStore.java:6-36`: `put(id, SecretValue, expectedRevision)`, `resolve(id)`, `delete(id, expectedRevision)`, `rotateToActiveKey()`; `ResolvedCredential(credentialId, revision, secret)` with redacted `toString()`.
- **SQLite adapter** — `ji-java\adapters\ji-credential-sqlite\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\credential\sqlite\SqliteCredentialStore.java`.
- **`DataDirectoryMasterKeyResolver`** — `ji-java\core\ji-security-api\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\security\secret\DataDirectoryMasterKeyResolver.java`. This is the master-key ACL utility you're after: `FILE_NAME = "master-key"` (`:47`), `KEY_ID = "data-directory"` (`:49`), owner-only POSIX `0600` (`:50-51`, `:166-178`), and the Windows ACL path `requireAclOwnerOnly` (`:181-196`) / `setOwnerOnly` (`:202-215`) which **replaces the whole ACL with a single owner entry**, dropping inherited grants. Also `requireRegularNonLinkFile()` at `:157-164` (symlink refusal). Interface: `MasterKeyResolver`, `MasterKey`.
- **Data-directory resolution helpers** (no shared utility class — each caller re-derives it):
  - `LocalHostApplication.configuredDataDirectory(env)` — `ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\LocalHostApplication.java:187-192`: `JI_DATA_DIR` else `${user.home}/.ji`, then `toAbsolutePath().normalize()`. Also `configuredHostId` at `:178-185` (default `"local-host"`, regex-validated) and port-locator file handling at `:204-243`.
  - `LocalHostApplication.open(...)` at `:59-63` shows the canonical `LocalHostServer` construction (13-arg ctor) and where `HostRelayConnector` is attached (`:65-70`).
- **`HostCredentialServices`** — `ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\HostCredentialServices.java:69-78`: `sqlite(Path database, MasterKeyResolver keys)` factory; injected-resolver variant at `:65-67`.
- **`CredentialApplicationService`** — `ji-host-core\...\CredentialApplicationService.java`. `SCOPE = "credential:manage"` (`:29`), `MAXIMUM_VALUE_BYTES = 4096` (`:31`); authorization is deliberately centralized here so the REST entry and the relay HCP entry cannot diverge (`:14-19`, `requireScope` at `:95-98` denies a `null` principal). It is the sole producer of credential audit events.
- **`ConnectionPrincipal`** — `ji-host-core\...\ConnectionPrincipal.java:7-43`: record `(connectionId, clientId, deviceId, hostId, transport, routeId, HostRole role, Set<String> scopes, Instant authenticatedAt)`; `require(scope)` throws `SecurityException("Host scope denied")` (`:30-32`); convenience factory `localAdmin(...)` at `:34-37` (unused by `LocalHostServer`, which builds its own at `:584-587`).
- Device identity: `HostDeviceRegistry`, `HostDeviceChallengeService` (`ji-host-core\...\HostDeviceChallengeService.java:49-51` — `verify(...)` takes `transport` and `routeId`, which is exactly where "direct" vs "relay" is stamped onto a real principal).

### Notable observations for whatever you're building

1. `guard()` is the correct single choke point for a loopback-subject/origin check — every route including `/` already funnels through it (`:252-271`), and it already owns the error→`problem()` conversion.
2. `requireAuthenticated()` is called by every `/api/v1/*` route **except** `exchange()` and the two `health()`. `staticAsset` is unauthenticated by design.
3. `localPrincipal()` hard-codes `"direct"`, so a relay-connected device can never reach it — but nothing today *prevents* an orchestrating route from being added to the HCP path; that separation is convention, not a type-level guard.
4. `RetentionLog.ALLOWED_FIELDS` must be extended before any new audit event's fields survive (`RetentionLog.java:24-27`).

      "credentialId", "revision", "role", "transport", "mode", "previousMode", "source");
  ```
  Non-allowlisted fields are silently dropped at `:44-51` — so any new audit event must add its field names to this set. `Entry` record is `(id, occurredAt, type, fields)`.
- Existing callers: `CredentialApplicationService.java:60` and `:69` (credential writes/clears); `ProviderProfileApplicationService.java:67-71` (permission-mode change). `SecurityAuditLog` is **not** wired into `LocalHostServer` at all today — the REST surface never emits audit entries.
- Tests: `ji-host-core\src\test\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\SecurityAuditLogTest.java`.

## 7. Credential store / master-key ACL / data-directory helpers

- **`CredentialStore` interface** — `ji-java\core\ji-security-api\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\security\secret\CredentialStore.java:6-36`: `put(id, SecretValue, expectedRevision)`, `resolve(id)`, `delete(id, expectedRevision)`, `rotateToActiveKey()`; `ResolvedCredential(credentialId, revision, secret)` with redacted `toString()`.
- **SQLite adapter** — `ji-java\adapters\ji-credential-sqlite\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\credential\sqlite\SqliteCredentialStore.java`.
- **`DataDirectoryMasterKeyResolver`** — `ji-java\core\ji-security-api\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\security\secret\DataDirectoryMasterKeyResolver.java`. This is the master-key ACL utility you're after: `FILE_NAME = "master-key"` (`:47`), `KEY_ID = "data-directory"` (`:49`), owner-only POSIX `0600` (`:50-51`, `:166-178`), and the Windows ACL path `requireAclOwnerOnly` (`:181-196`) / `setOwnerOnly` (`:202-215`) which **replaces the whole ACL with a single owner entry**, dropping inherited grants. Also `requireRegularNonLinkFile()` at `:157-164` (symlink refusal). Interface: `MasterKeyResolver`, `MasterKey`.
- **Data-directory resolution helpers** (no shared utility class — each caller re-derives it):
  - `LocalHostApplication.configuredDataDirectory(env)` — `ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\LocalHostApplication.java:187-192`: `JI_DATA_DIR` else `${user.home}/.ji`, then `toAbsolutePath().normalize()`. Also `configuredHostId` at `:178-185` (default `"local-host"`, regex-validated) and port-locator file handling at `:204-243`.
  - `LocalHostApplication.open(...)` at `:59-63` shows the canonical `LocalHostServer` construction (13-arg ctor) and where `HostRelayConnector` is attached (`:65-70`).
- **`HostCredentialServices`** — `ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\HostCredentialServices.java:69-78`: `sqlite(Path database, MasterKeyResolver keys)` factory; injected-resolver variant at `:65-67`.
- **`CredentialApplicationService`** — `ji-host-core\...\CredentialApplicationService.java`. `SCOPE = "credential:manage"` (`:29`), `MAXIMUM_VALUE_BYTES = 4096` (`:31`); authorization is deliberately centralized here so the REST entry and the relay HCP entry cannot diverge (`:14-19`, `requireScope` at `:95-98` denies a `null` principal). It is the sole producer of credential audit events.
- **`ConnectionPrincipal`** — `ji-host-core\...\ConnectionPrincipal.java:7-43`: record `(connectionId, clientId, deviceId, hostId, transport, routeId, HostRole role, Set<String> scopes, Instant authenticatedAt)`; `require(scope)` throws `SecurityException("Host scope denied")` (`:30-32`); convenience factory `localAdmin(...)` at `:34-37` (unused by `LocalHostServer`, which builds its own at `:584-587`).
- Device identity: `HostDeviceRegistry`, `HostDeviceChallengeService` (`ji-host-core\...\HostDeviceChallengeService.java:49-51` — `verify(...)` takes `transport` and `routeId`, which is exactly where "direct" vs "relay" is stamped onto a real principal).

### Notable observations for whatever you're building

1. `guard()` is the correct single choke point for a loopback-subject/origin check — every route including `/` already funnels through it (`:252-271`), and it already owns the error→`problem()` conversion.
2. `requireAuthenticated()` is called by every `/api/v1/*` route **except** `exchange()` and the two `health()`. `staticAsset` is unauthenticated by design.
3. `localPrincipal()` hard-codes `"direct"`, so a relay-connected device can never reach it — but nothing today *prevents* an orchestrating route from being added to the HCP path; that separation is convention, not a type-level guard.
4. `RetentionLog.ALLOWED_FIELDS` must be extended before any new audit event's fields survive (`RetentionLog.java:24-27`).
